prompt:
A static medium shot holds on her, seen from the hips up. The camera is locked on a tripod and stays there for the whole shot: the same lens, the same height, the same distance. Keep her position and her distance from the camera exactly as in the image.

She is proud of her pupil, and she laughs at herself: it took her a year to say that word.

She says « very good », then says one short thing about herself with a small laugh. She speaks towards a point just beyond the left edge of the picture, level with her own eyes. Let her face follow the voice.

Her hand stays on the black handle of her shopping trolley, exactly as in the image.

Across her chest we see only her navy coat and her plain white blouse, from the first frame to the last.

On the left of the picture, between her and the edge of the frame, the top of her trolley and the sunny street run on, open and quiet, from the first frame to the last.

Finally she stops speaking and her mouth closes into a warm smile that stays. She blinks, she breathes, and she holds that expression the whole time she waits.

Behind her the sunny street stays quiet, soft and out of focus. Her eyes rest on a fixed point just beyond the left edge of the frame and stay there for the whole shot.

The framing holds to the very end: in the last frame she is the same size and in the same place in the picture as in the first.
